sources.fact: Official notice lists comprehensive building room 1302; supports at least 13 floors, not total height.
Library at building 18 includes room 411; at least four floors, not a measured height.
Campus youth publication identifies buildings 1,2,3-8,9,19. Old publication; current facade conditions not certified.
Campus youth arts publication provides gym photograph; photographs are references only.
Official 2023 report describes new 13/10/9-floor buildings; old map does not identify their footprints reliably. NOT applied to old map buildings.
Official source identifies building 11 as small highrise; exact floor count not stated.
Planning map footprints and labels; no elevation or floor data.

default_profile.notes: No reliable building-specific elevation evidence yet.
